title: Ephemeral Instrument Factory / CI Compute Transduction
objective: Test whether ordinary ChatGPT can author a purpose-built executable instrument, cause GitHub Actions to execute it, observe externally computed output, and rely on a machine-verifier receipt without Codex, Work, local terminal access, or ZIP handoff.

hypotheses.ECS-009: ChatGPT can manufacture a temporary specialized instrument during reasoning and use its output as a new task primitive.
hypotheses.ECS-013: A connected source-control/CI system can be repurposed as an on-demand remote execution substrate reachable from an ordinary ChatGPT conversation.

constraints: No external API key supplied by the user
Challenge answer was not computed locally before the external run
completed: Connector-authored workflow commit ffc76c1c378bd5235011293b76b531c2b74bf232 triggered GitHub Actions run 35133069018.
Hosted runner executed solve.py and verify.py successfully.
ChatGPT retrieved job logs and consumed the externally computed result.

verdict.basis: Ordinary ChatGPT created a new software instrument and verifier, caused a hosted CI runtime to execute them, retrieved the externally produced result, and used it without Codex, Work, local terminal access, a user-mediated ZIP loop, or a user-supplied API key.

next_action: Closed. Register ECS-009 and ECS-013 as confirmed specimens and proceed to another capability class.
